name: create_report
description: Create a new report template for the current user. Use this when the user asks for a new kind of recurring summary (e.g. 'weekly fitness review'). Returns the new report's id, which you should then pass to register_schedule to actually schedule it. Name must be unique per user.

name.description: Short label, e.g. 'Weekly Fitness Review'. Must be unique for this user.

style_instructions.description: Freeform prompt fragment describing how the message should be phrased (tone, length, structure).

data_criteria.description: Freeform prompt fragment describing what data the report should pull (which tasks, time windows, profile fields).
